dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、朝ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's morning now, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "It's morning now, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 頭の上で萌先輩の声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I can hear Moe-sempai's voice above my head.
dialogues.text: I can hear Moe-sempai's voice above my head.

dialogues.jp: なんだ、ちゃんと起きれるんじゃん……。
dialogues.en: She woke up on time, huh......?
dialogues.text: She woke up on time, huh......?

dialogues.jp: （それにしても、いま何時だ？）
dialogues.en: (By the way, what time is it now?)
dialogues.text: (By the way, what time is it now?)

dialogues.jp: まだ目覚ましは鳴ってないはずだけど……。
dialogues.en: I don't think the alarm has gone off yet......
dialogues.text: I don't think the alarm has gone off yet......

dialogues.jp: ゴンッ――！！
dialogues.en: Bang!!
dialogues.text: Bang!!

dialogues.jp: 頭部に強烈な一撃が加えられる。
dialogues.en: I felt a strong pressure in my head.
dialogues.text: I felt a strong pressure in my head.

dialogues.jp:
目を開けるが、まだ火花が散っていて何も見え
ない。それにおでこが焼けるように痛い……。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes, but all I could see were stars. My
forehead was burning with pain......
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes, but all I could see were stars. My
forehead was burning with pain......

dialogues.jp: （……なんだ……いまのは……？）
dialogues.en: (......What the heck was that......?)
dialogues.text: (......What the heck was that......?)

dialogues.jp:
徐々に視力が回復するにつれ、人の輪郭が見え
てくる。
dialogues.en:
My vision recovered gradually, and I saw a silhouette of
someone.
dialogues.text:
My vision recovered gradually, and I saw a silhouette of
someone.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩が、なんとか見えるよう
になる。
dialogues.en: I could barely see Moe-sempai smiling at me.
dialogues.text: I could barely see Moe-sempai smiling at me.

dialogues.jp: 「いったい……なにが……」
dialogues.en: "What...... happened......?"
dialogues.text: "What...... happened......?"

dialogues.jp: ふと、萌先輩が手に持っているものに気付く。
dialogues.en: I realized what Moe-sempai was holding in her hand.
dialogues.text: I realized what Moe-sempai was holding in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
「……あの……なんでフライパンを持っている
　んです？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Why do you have a frying pan in your hand?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Why do you have a frying pan in your hand?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が、自分の持っているフライパンをきょ
とんと見つめる。
dialogues.en: She looked at the skillet she was holding in her hand.
dialogues.text: She looked at the skillet she was holding in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「眞子ちゃんがフライパンで叩いて起こすと、
　男の子は喜ぶと教えてくれたので、キッチン
　から持ってきたんです」
dialogues.en:
"Mako-chan told me that boys like to be woken up by being
hit with a frying pan. That's why I brought this from the
kitchen."
dialogues.text:
"Mako-chan told me that boys like to be woken up by being
hit with a frying pan. That's why I brought this from the
kitchen."

dialogues.jp: 先ほどの一撃は、そういうことか……。
dialogues.en: That's what that was all about......
dialogues.text: That's what that was all about......

dialogues.jp:
「……そういう起こし方は、なかなか起きない
　ときにするもんです」
dialogues.en:
"......You use that method only when they aren't waking
up......"
dialogues.text:
"......You use that method only when they aren't waking
up......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
と言うか、本当に叩かれて喜ぶかはかなり微妙
な気がする。
dialogues.en:
Besides, I don't know if anyone would like to be woken up
like that.
dialogues.text:
Besides, I don't know if anyone would like to be woken up
like that.

dialogues.jp:
それにしてもなんだか頭がズキズキ、ヒリヒリ
する。
dialogues.en: Anyway, my head's pounding and burning with pain.
dialogues.text: Anyway, my head's pounding and burning with pain.

dialogues.jp: ……ヒリヒリ？
dialogues.en: ......Burning?
dialogues.text: ......Burning?

dialogues.jp: ふと、フライパンに目を向ける。
dialogues.en: I took another look at the pan.
dialogues.text: I took another look at the pan.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、内側が油とかで汚れているように見
えるのは、俺の錯覚だろうか……。
dialogues.en:
If I'm not mistaken, it looks like the inside of it's dirty
with grease......
dialogues.text:
If I'm not mistaken, it looks like the inside of it's dirty
with grease......

dialogues.jp: 「あの……萌先輩……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Moe-sempai......?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Moe-sempai......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ここに来る前、何してました？」
dialogues.en: "What were you doing before you got here?"
dialogues.text: "What were you doing before you got here?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝食の仕度をしてました」
dialogues.en: "I was preparing breakfast."
dialogues.text: "I was preparing breakfast."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「…………そうですか」
（あちぃぃぃぃぃぃぃ――――――――ッ！）
フライパン＋αなんてイベント、ありか！？
dialogues.en: She hit me with a burning hot frying pan?
dialogues.text: She hit me with a burning hot frying pan?

dialogues.jp: ある意味、両手持ちよりキツイぞ。
dialogues.en: I'd rather be hit with two normal frying pans!
dialogues.text: I'd rather be hit with two normal frying pans!

dialogues.jp: （いや、それもかなりヤバイが……）
dialogues.en: (On second thought, not really......)
dialogues.text: (On second thought, not really......)

dialogues.jp: はぁ……。

「とにかく、起きましょう……手を貸してもら
　えますか？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let me get up...... Will you lend me a hand?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let me get up...... Will you lend me a hand?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の手を借りて起き上がる。
dialogues.en: I took her hand and got up.
dialogues.text: I took her hand and got up.

dialogues.jp:
「えーと、着替えますんで、萌先輩は先に下に
　行っていてください」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'm going to get changed, so will you wait for me
downstairs?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'm going to get changed, so will you wait for me
downstairs?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。それじゃあ、朝食の用意をしてますね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I'll prepare your breakfast then."
dialogues.text: "Okay. I'll prepare your breakfast then."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が出て行ったあと、ぐったりと溜め息を
吐く。
dialogues.en: I sighed after she left the room.
dialogues.text: I sighed after she left the room.

dialogues.jp:
おでこをさすると、見事なたんこぶが、出来上
がっていた……。
dialogues.en: When I rubbed my forehead, I found a huge bump there......
dialogues.text: When I rubbed my forehead, I found a huge bump there......

dialogues.jp: ◆フライパン◆
dialogues.en: ◆Frying pan◆
dialogues.text: ◆Frying pan◆

dialogues.jp:
フライパンでぶったたかれて目が覚めるという、
貴重な体験をしてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I had a rare experience of being hit with a frying pan as a
wakeup call.
dialogues.text:
I had a rare experience of being hit with a frying pan as a
wakeup call.

dialogues.jp: しかも、熱いし……。
dialogues.en: It was burning hot too......
dialogues.text: It was burning hot too......
